skill.label: 色彩と文化：中・近世のヨーロッパの色彩（写本・顔料・材料）

derivationRule: Use only the narrow p.007 nonvisual facts resolved in the source audit: medieval manuscript pigment material origins and preparation, Getty pigment examples, Met Belles Heures ultramarine/lapis relation, and the specific National Gallery Lorenzo Monaco material record. Do not infer symbolism, universal palettes, exact pigment prices, universal value rankings, RGB/HEX/display values, image appearance, or exhaustive unpublished AFT-text membership.
